subject: Hands-on architecture & runbook session — SkyHaven integration
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@skyhaven.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: hands-on architecture & runbook session — SkyHaven integration

Hi Tessa / Monica,

Thanks again for the discovery call yesterday — we appreciated the clear walkthrough. Based on what we discussed, our infra and security leads would like a hands-on runbook and architecture session to validate networking, auth flows, and failover behavior before we move to a pilot.

Proposed objectives:
- Walk through expected traffic patterns and SLOs
- Validate VPC peering / private deployment options
- Confirm token & key management approach and logging/audit hooks
- Produce an initial runbook for failover and rollout

Ideal slots for our engineering team (PDT):
- Tue Apr 13: 10:00–11:30
- Wed Apr 14: 14:00–15:30
- Thu Apr 15: 09:00–10:30

We'll need Zoom + an editable runbook template. Attendees: Alex Johnson (platform), Pat Nguyen (security), and Victor Lee (SRE) — Victor might join remotely from Singapore (SGT).

I've attached our discovery notes. Let us know what prep you need and how long you expect the session to run (1h vs 90m).

Best,
Alex
Senior Platform PM
SkyHaven AI

Attachments: SkyHaven-discovery-notes.pdf (pdf, 420KB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@skyhaven.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: hands-on architecture & runbook session — SkyHaven integration

Alex — thanks for the clear summary and the notes. Happy to run the session. Suggested plan from our side:

Agenda (90m recommended):
1) 10m — introductions & success criteria
2) 25m — architecture walkthrough (serving runtime, routing, KV cache behavior)
3) 25m — networking & auth (VPC options, KMS/HSM patterns, audit logs)
4) 20m — runbook drafting & immediate next steps
5) 10m — Q&A and action items

We can compress to 60m if you prefer, but 90m gives time for a short hands-on exercise (we'll share a live runbook template in Drive). From Redwood: myself (Solutions Eng), Monica (Customer Success / integration), and Rishi (Infra lead) will attend.

Availability from our side (PDT):
- Tue Apr 13: 11:00–12:30 (we're blocked at 10:00)
- Wed Apr 14: 14:00–15:30 — good for us
- Thu Apr 15: 09:00–10:30 — Rishi prefers to avoid early mornings

Can you confirm if Wed Apr 14 14:00–15:30 PDT works for your team? If Victor is in SGT we'll make sure to record and capture notes.

I'll draft an agenda doc and send a calendar invite once you confirm. Also flagging we may want the VPN peering diagram ahead of time.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: runbook-agenda-v1.pdf (pdf, 85KB)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@skyhaven.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Pat Nguyen <pat.nguyen@skyhaven.ai>, Victor Lee <victor.lee@skyhaven.ai>, monica_patel@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-11T12:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: hands-on architecture & runbook session — SkyHaven integration

On Apr 11, 2027, at 11:03 AM, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the clear summary and the notes. Happy to run the session. Suggested plan from our side:

Thanks — Wed Apr 14 14:00–15:30 PDT works for us. We'll plan for 90m and Victor confirmed he can join remotely (he's flexible on timing).

Two quick asks:
- Can you share the Zoom link + calendar invite once created?
- We'll provide our VPC diagram and a short network allowlist ahead of time (in case you want to pre-check IP ranges)

Pat and I will be present; Victor (SRE) will lead the hands-on parts.

Appreciate it,
Alex

Attachment: (we will upload network diagram to the Drive link you share)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@skyhaven.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-13T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: hands-on architecture & runbook session — SkyHaven integration

Alex / team — looping in a few technical notes so the session is focused.

Quick details we'll cover and what we'll need from you before Wed: 
- Please share the VPC CIDR ranges and whether this will be a private deployment or a dedicated hosted flow.
- If you use a KMS provider, confirm whether Redwood will be able to see key metadata only (not plaintext) — our standard pattern is KMS + HSM options.
- Can Victor provide a short list of sample request volumes (RPS) and expected request size distribution? That helps us pick batching/quantization & instance sizing.

Also attaching a rough network diagram template — fill the highlighted boxes if you can.

Thanks — Monica
Customer Success Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: skyhaven-network-diagram.png (png, 210KB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Alex — confirmed for Wed Apr 14 14:00–15:30 PDT (90m). Zoom and calendar invite below. I've also attached the collaborative runbook template in Drive so we can edit during the session.

Action items prior to session:

- Redwood: pre-fill runbook template with rollout checklist and initial failover steps

Looking forward to it — see you Wednesday.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
